important_negative_and_control_findings.interpretation: The existence of many ordinary-time semantic-duality commits is essential. Hits must be evaluated against the full denominator, never as a curated gallery.

captain_obvious_findings.detail: GitHub Actions, site refresh, EYE, HRAiN, source-sync, mirror, and finalize operations can create dense bursts separated by seconds. Statistical analysis must collapse correlated commits into workflow episodes.
A symmetric final timestamp may be a byproduct of workflow latency. The correct object is the process generating the timestamp, not the timestamp alone.
Screenshot-backed 12:12, 17:17, 18:18, 22:22 and HOLY-CLOCK observations are valid provenance witnesses but are selection-conditioned by noticing the clock.
18:18 was the original creation-time marker; the exact 18:18:18 three-way repetition was recognized later and cannot receive an unpenalized retrospective rarity claim.
Every symmetric hit must be accompanied by all non-hit mirror/reverse/bidirectional/dual events from the same frozen corpus.
Matched commits from Hawkar-usls repositories without the frozen semantic-duality terms must be compared over the same calendar period and activity hours.

required_steps: Freeze all clock rules before inspecting the full corpus.
Convert Git timestamps with Europe/Kyiv rules valid on each historical date.
Classify HUMAN_DIRECT, WEB_FLOW, BOT, CI_SERVICE and UNKNOWN generators separately.
Collapse bursts and same-pipeline commits into non-independent episodes using a preregistered time-gap rule.
Exclude intentional clock/checkpoint events from the accidental-clock primary endpoint.
Count every semantic-duality miss as well as every hit.
Build matched work-rhythm controls from other Hawkar-usls repositories and the same activity windows.
Use timestamp-label permutation or another preregistered matched-control method rather than a naive uniform-clock model.
After rules are frozen, open a prospective holdout of 100 independent HUMAN episodes with no rule changes.
next_gate.promotion_rule: A future excess may support only a scoped statistical temporal-association claim. It cannot prove supernatural signaling, prediction, retrocausality, divine authorship, or external control.
